key_insight: A sentiment-augmented deep reinforcement learning framework can improve daily crypto and stock trading decisions, with DDPG delivering the best overall test performance in this study.
engineering_relevance: The paper shows how combining market indicators, news sentiment, and an alpha-based reward can be used to build and tune automated trading agents for practical financial decision support.
method: Formulate trading as a discrete-action MDP with long/flat/short decisions for BTC and TSLA.
Use technical indicators, cyclical calendar features, and LLaMA 3.2 1B news sentiment scores as state inputs.
Compare PG, PPO, DQL, and DDPG with Ray Tune hyperparameter search and validation Sharpe-based model selection.
evidence_signal: The system was evaluated on the CLEF 2026 FinMMEval Task 3 benchmark, where DDPG achieved 54.96% cumulative return on TSLA and 1.58% on BTC, while the validation-selected DQL model was chosen for the live endpoint.
watch_item: There is a notable validation-to-test generalization gap, suggesting that models tuned in bull-market conditions may underperform when deployed in different market regimes.
paper_title: CLaC@FinMMEval 2026 Task 3: Sentiment-Augmented Deep Reinforcement Learning for Active Trading -- An Alpha-Reward Approach
